note: KOA Holiday (formerly The Oaks at Sacred Rocks RV Park) on about 40 acres of oaks in the high desert off CA 94 near Boulevard, roughly 60 mi east of San Diego; pool, zipline, farm animals, disc golf and trails. Follow the operator's directions rather than GPS, which can route onto dirt roads. --Claude
summary: KOA booking form re-quoted live (koa.py): cheapest site a 23-ft rig fits $44 (Value, Jan 2027) / $49.50 (May 2027), dearest $99; passes the price gate. Google 4.6/138; year-round; 50 A full hookups, 60-ft max, laundry/store/wifi/showers. Not waterfront; pin fine. Long-stay tests pass.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes. Cheapest real RV night a 23-ft rig fits = $44.00 Value Site (2027-01-12) and $49.50 (2027-05-18), both before tax. The $40 Compact Camping Site is excluded as sized for small units ('not recommended for large RVs, class A motorhomes, or oversized trailers'). No gateway within 40 km; not a Good Sam Park; KOA Rewards 10% is an operator member discount on top.

LONG-STAY: passes all five tests - nightly rates sold online for one night across nine site types, no minimum on either date, 'Extended Stays' listed only as one more way to stay, not a home community. Nightly-dominant KOA Holiday; no caveat needed.

ACCESS: operator says 'DO NOT RELY ON GPS, IT MIGHT TAKE YOU DOWN DIRT ROADS' and the entrance is 'right before the dirt road starts' - the posted route is paved (I-8, Church Rd or Ribbonwood Rd, CA 94, Shasta Way). No 4WD or rig statement; not a drop. Put in the note.
PHONE: keep 619-766-4480 (the campground's own 'Reserve: 1-619-766-4480' on koa.com). Google shows KOA's central 800-562-0271.
WEBSITE: https://koa.com/campgrounds/boulevard/ confirmed (Wayback 20260301; live koa.com 403s plain fetches, booking form read through the browser).
PIN: stored 32.64606,-116.34488 lies in the east RV loop; Google's 32.64577,-116.34766 is the office ~260 m west. No move.
NOT WATERFRONT kept (only a koi pond). Open, year-round.
